name: inbox-row
title: Inbox row
description: A message list row: sender, subject, snippet, time, unread and starred states, labels and an attachment mark.
docs: Put the rows in a ul. message is { id, sender, image, subject, snippet, time, unread, starred, attachment, labels, href }. The whole row opens the message (a link with href, a button with onOpen) and sits under the checkbox (onSelect, selected) and the star (onStar), which are separate controls. An unread message is set heavier, has a dot and says Unread to screen readers. density is comfortable (three lines, with an avatar) or compact (one line from 42rem wide, two below it); showAvatar overrides the default. The time reads as a clock time for today, the weekday for the last six days and then the date; pass now to fix it.
